# Odalys Naskdale

Odalys Naskdale is the Crane Operations Manager at Zorrel Analytics, a leading provider of advanced berth scheduling software known for predicting optimal vessel docking times. Since joining Zorrel Analytics in 2019, Odalys has played a pivotal role in integrating crane telemetry data with predictive scheduling algorithms to enhance overall terminal efficiency.

Her career spans over 12 years in maritime port operations, beginning as a junior logistics coordinator at Westport Container Services (2008–2013), where she first gained hands-on experience with container tracking and customs clearance processes. From 2013 to 2017, she served as the Crane Efficiency Supervisor at Blue Harbor Terminal, focusing on optimizing container loading sequences to reduce berth occupation times and cut down turnaround delays.

In 2017, Odalys joined HarborGate Terminal as Senior Operations Lead and spearheaded the automation upgrade project codenamed Project Waveform. This initiative involved deploying real-time crane telemetry integration and AI-driven load sequencing, which reduced average container loading times by 15% and improved crane utilization rates by 22%. Her leadership on Project Waveform was widely regarded as a benchmark within port operations circles.

Odalys specializes in optimizing container loading sequences to maximize crane throughput while minimizing vessel idle times. She is known for a data-driven, detail-oriented working style that balances operational pragmatism with innovative technology adoption. She is adept at translating complex telemetry outputs and berth scheduling predictions into actionable workflows for crane operators and terminal supervisors.

Within Zorrel Analytics, Odalys collaborates closely with the berth scheduling algorithm team, software engineers, and terminal operations analysts. She also maintains strong working relationships with customer terminal managers and crane equipment manufacturers to ensure seamless integration of hardware telemetry with scheduling software.

Odalys continues to advance port operations efficiency through her combined expertise in crane telemetry, container logistics, and scheduling prediction technologies.
